text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One evening. After finishing up a few small errands,
I was walking through the shopping district when—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oh? Trainer, there's a crowd gathering up ahead. Could a traveling sorcerer have arrived?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Hey you with the Daruma ornament on your head!
Care to give it a try if you like~?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The! Lottery! Hyowawawa, here it comes!
It's practically begging me to pull it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: A fortune slip that comes with a prize—what a dreamy event! I simply have to try it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, do you have 100 yen?
100 yen! ...Wait, no, a raffle ticket!
choice_data_list: I got one when I went shopping, if I recall...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, in that case! Let us do this,
hand in hand, combining our strengths!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If we combine your luck with my luck, Trainer...
...yep, yep! There's nothing to be afraid of!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Focusing our hopes and wishes,
we gripped the raffle lever together...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Eeeeeeek...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With an unusually high-tension scream,
the raffle drum is spun round and round.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result is—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, how festive, how wonderful!
Grand Prize! Truly the greatest blessing!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
There really are both gods and buddhas in this world!
To think they'd repay my daily good deeds twice over!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Wah-hoi, wah-hoi, wah-hoi-hoi~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Humming a traditional tune no one had ever heard, Matikane Fukukitaru was in the absolute heights of joy.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, I got it!
Now we can go together, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: In that case, all that's left is deciding when to depart. Since this is a treasure hunt journey, we must choose an auspicious day.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
To pick a date, an omikuji fortune is the way to go,
right? ...Is that okay with you?
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'll leave it to you.
Yeah, I'll leave it up to you.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's move on to Round 2
of today's lottery!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And so, we came to the shrine to let a fortune slip decide the date.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's a 'Travel' section on the omikuji.
I'll see what it says and decide based on that.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
*rummage rummage*...
Alright, this is it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Gyohooooooooh, wh-what is this!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "Well, this is unexpected! It's not just 'departing soon brings good fortune' or 'the northeast is auspicious'..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Look what it says!
"Let's hold out for one year♪" it says.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Why is it written
in such casual slang~~~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One year... That revelation seems to demand
a rather long period of patience.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ah, how regrettable. But if it is a revelation from God, I have no choice but to obey.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Good things come to those who wait! Surely there must be
a reason for this that is higher than the sea
and lower than the mountains.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Trainer! In one year! In one year, will you promise to go on a hot springs trip with me?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Worry not! The hot springs aren't going anywhere! 
And if they do run off, I shall give chase.
choice_data_list: Got it, then see you in a year!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ohh!
It's a promise, okay? A promise!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
When that time comes, let us soak in the blessed hot springs
and savor the local delicacies.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Get your tastebuds ready! Ready, go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Boing!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The promised drum echoes. Aiming for the hot springs
a year from now, Matikanefukukitaru's motivation
seems to have skyrocketed.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oho, even if it's not the grand prize, this is quite a lavish reward! It's a Moderate Luck!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mhfufufu, packed with nutrients, a heavenly bite—
what a truly delicious-looking hamburger steak.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
This auspicious crimson shade of carrot
is truly something else...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hmm?
Still, it's just one step short of satisfying.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
This still lacks the festivity fitting for the start of the New Year.
To make this Salisbury steak even more auspicious...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
Trainer, please follow my lead!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I followed along
wherever Matikanefukukitaru led me.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I borrowed the kitchen here for a bit,
and poured a whooole bunch of cream sauce
all over the hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Alright, all done! A red-and-white hamburg steak
blending the red of carrots and the white of cream!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, congratulations~! Come on, Trainer,
let's dig right in!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two of us enjoyed the Hamburg steaks topped with
the original sauce. It was exceptionally creamy,
rich, and utterly delicious!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, carrots? The portion is more than enough...
so I'd say this counts as 'Mild Luck'.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Let us gratefully accept
whatever is offered to us.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "Still, keeping this whole amount to myself feels like it'd bring down divine punishment on me."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Trainer!
Let's set off on an 88-shrine carrot pilgrimage
to share with everyone!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, to hand out the extra carrots we received, we decided to make the rounds to the other horse girls.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Fukukitaru.
I'll eat it during a break in training.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oho! A carrot? You shouldn't have, dammit!
Don't mind if I do!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'm in your debt.
With this one bottle—I'm doubling down.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After handing out about three of them—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Whoa, wait a second! If we keep handing them out at this rate, we won't have any time left to sleep!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Let's just eat the rest right here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the 88-temple pilgrimage was cut short after just three.
Having eaten so much without exercising much, their bellies were full.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! Just a single one~?!
Well, knock me down with a feather!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If I had to compare it to an omikuji... it'd be a 'Good Luck'.
No, actually, just 'Regular'... perfectly average...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Was 'Regular' ever an option for fortunes?
It kinda sounds like ordering an unagi bowl.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well, even just one will do as a snack.
Let's eat it quickly,
Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Splitting one in half to share and eat, and then—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Did you finish it? You did, right?
Then to celebrate finishing that single skewer, let's do a single-clap salute!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Yooo-ho!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A strange rhythmic clapping echoed around. Finishing with a formal clap,
it felt like spirits were lifted just a bit.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Tissues~!? Is this that legendary total dud
spoken of since ancient times!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's bad luck! It's terrible luck... Total catastrophe!
Why did it turn out like this?! Waaah, so gloomy~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If it's come to this, Trainer,
let's fold some paper dolls with these tissues!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"It's an evil-warding charm, an amulet. Weave a vessel,
and let misfortune take its place instead~."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Come on, there's no time to rest.
Let's fold diligently! Fold, fold, fold!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the mountain of tissues
were all turned into paper dolls of sorrow.
